page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top centre above the text block. Main text in one column with a heading "GOMARVS." centred mid-page. Marginal notes in the left margin beside the lower paragraph (Matth. 15. 13.14. Hebr. 13.7.). Page number at top left.

main_text.p: corum grauiora) quòd sciant potestatem, non sanctitati, sed homini datam, vt Christi erga nos beneuolentia testatior esset & illustrior: qui ad populi sui consolationem, etiam per malos & flagitiosos ministros, gratiam suam voluerit, ad animos nostros, permanare. Et esto, sint plerique rectores populi mali, nullum tamen inde boni capiunt detrimentum, nisi vel impietatem Iudæ sanctis Apostolis vel impuritatem Nicolai Antiocheni reliquis sex diaconis, vel quarundam leuium fœminarum turpitudinem, honestissimis prudentissimisque matronis, fraudi ac crimini fuisse dicere velimus.
main_text.head: GOMARVS.
main_text.p: AVDIO quid in Pontificijs collaudes, Coltere, sed errorem vestrorum hominum agnosco duplicem. Prior est vitæ; quòd in traditionibus humanis & varijs superstitionibus, vobis ducibus, contra Dei mandatum Matth. 15.13.14.Hebr. 13.7.parent. Præpositis enim, ex Apostoli sententia, obediendum est, non quibusuis; sed ijs, qui verbum Dei docent.

page.notes: Marginal notes in the left margin are small and partly faded; the reference "Hebr. 13.7." and "Matth. 15." are read from the scan. Some faint show-through in the lower half was omitted. The paragraph beginning "AVDIO" has a large woodcut-style initial A. The first word "corum" may be a fragment continuing from the previous page.
